integrity: Analytic recurrence and disjoint-support proof; finite outward interval verification is confined to two explicit sine moments with rigorous analytic tail.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Fourier nonvanishing is proved only at positive and negative integer powers of two, not for all real frequencies; spectrality remains open. Published preprint full text could not be inspected; equivalence risk persists. The general Fourier nondecay and classical Parry construction are prior facts.
title: Sharp dyadic Parry limit and lacunary Fourier nonvanishing for a golden-mean measure
